trap.label: vogal curta × longa
trap.wrong: We saw a sheep in the harbor. (barco)
trap.right: We saw a ship in the harbor.
trap.why: O português não distingue vogal curta e longa, então ship (/ɪ/) e sheep (/iː/) parecem iguais e a grafia sai trocada.

fix.wrong: We saw a ship in the field. (ovelha)
fix.right: We saw a sheep in the field.

fix.wrong: The sheep is in the port. (barco)
fix.right: The ship is in the port.

rewrite.prompt: Troque pela palavra que significa barco: “The sheep is big.”
Troque pela palavra que significa ovelha: “The ship is white.”
Coloque no plural com two: “one sheep”
